summary: Another AI-hardware sell-off day (AMAT, LRCX, ANET, MU, SMCI, APP down 8-12%) is market-wide fear, not a business break. In buy range, Sprouts (SFM) fell about 17% more in 5 days on a Q3 pricing reset and affordability spend (WATCH). TBBK and NMIH stay WATCH with unconfirmed causes. AppLovin (on deck) is near its MOS and needs a look at Q3 results. Kenvue's 8-K flags are the Kimberly-Clark deal closing. No dossier sell trigger tripped. Causes for IBKR, TBBK and RMD are unconfirmed. Not investment advice.
